newsitem.title: USA: Harcourt to acquire Pearson unit.
newsitem.headline: Harcourt to acquire Pearson unit.

text.p: Harcourt General Inc said Friday it has signed a definitive agreement to buy Churchill Livingstone, a medical publisher, from Pearson plc, for about $92.5 million in cash.
The closing of the acquisition is subject to U.S. and U.K, regulatory review, the U.S. publisher said.
It said it hopes to complete the deal before the end of its fiscal year on October 31.
Richard Smith, chairman of Harcourt General, said the acquisition of Churchill Livingstone was a strategic move that would strengthen the U.S. company's international presence.
He said Churchill Livingstone was expected to contribute to earnings in its full year after the deal is completed.
